title: The Sheep Divided From The Goats — The Gathered Sifted At The Throne Of His Glory
summary: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.* (Matthew 25:31-33). *All nations* names where the gathered come from. The seed was scattered among all the nations, and at his coming it is gathered out of them — and then sifted. Ezekiel saw the sifting and where it happens: *And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face... And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Ezekiel 20:35, 37-38). The goats are parted from the sheep among the gathered, before the reign — not the nations judged for entry into it. The measure is mercy shown to *one of the least of these my brethren* (Matthew 25:40), and the brethren are the seed: *for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren* (Hebrews 2:11). The sheep *inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world* (Matthew 25:34) and enter the land as a kingdom of priests to the nations left alive (Zechariah 14:16); the goats are sent toward *everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). The warning was always given to the wheat.

2917.prose: Here is what the sifting weighs. Yahusha (Jesus) names the measure himself, and it is mercy shown to *the least of these my brethren*. The sheep are the gathered who showed that mercy to the least of the seed while all of them were out among the nations, and what was done to them he counts as done to him.
2917.phrase: Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren
2917.sentence: The measure at the throne is mercy shown to his brethren, and he takes it as shown to himself.

2918.prose: The parting ends in two roads. Those on the left go away into *everlasting punishment*, and the righteous go into *life eternal*. The sifting at the throne is what sends each group on, the goats divided from the sheep among the gathered.
2918.phrase: these shall go away into everlasting punishment
2918.sentence: The two ends of the parting: the goats go to punishment and the righteous go into life.

2919.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says it to Peter ahead of time. The Son of Adam sits on the throne of his glory, and those who followed him sit on twelve thrones over *the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)*. The ones before the throne are that bloodline people, the scattered seed being gathered and sorted.
2919.phrase: judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)
2919.sentence: The throne of his glory stands over the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), the people gathered and sifted there.

2920.prose: The same coming, seen from the other side. The sign of the Son of Adam shows in heaven, and *all the tribes of the earth mourn*. Just after this his angels gather the elect from the four winds. That gathering is what fills the place before the throne.
2920.phrase: they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven
2920.sentence: The coming in the clouds is the same coming, with the tribes gathered to it from the four winds.

2921.prose: His mother and *his brethren* stand outside while he speaks to the people, and he asks who his brethren are. The question is answered at the throne. The brethren he names there are the seed he came for, the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the ones who do the will of his Father.
2921.phrase: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without
2921.sentence: The question of who his brethren are is first raised here, and the throne gives the answer.

2922.prose: The shepherd who divides sheep from goats at the throne is the one Ezekiel heard say *will both search my sheep*. He seeks them first, out of every place they were scattered, and only then sorts them. The sifting is the shepherd's own work on his own flock.
2922.phrase: I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out
2922.sentence: The shepherd himself goes looking for his scattered sheep before he sorts them.

2923.prose: Ezekiel has the same sorting, and it falls inside the flock. He speaks to *my flock* and judges *between cattle and cattle*. The goats are among the sheep when he divides them. So the parting is among the gathered, the way the throne shows it, and not a trial of outsiders.
2923.phrase: I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats
2923.sentence: The parting of rams from he goats is made within the flock, which is how the throne divides the gathered.

2926.prose: Before the throne stand *all nations*, and Isaiah says why. He gathers them, and they come and *see my glory*. Two verses on it is your brethren who are brought out of all nations to his holy mountain. So all nations is where the gathered are called out of, the field the seed was scattered in.
2926.phrase: I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory
2926.sentence: The gathering out of all nations and tongues is the gathering the throne scene starts from.

2927.prose: Daniel saw *one like the Son of Adam* come with the clouds and be brought near before the Ancient of days. That is the coming Yahusha (Jesus) names. The next verse gives him dominion and a kingdom, so the one who sits to sort the gathered is the one given the kingdom.
2927.phrase: one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven
2927.sentence: Daniel's one like the Son of Adam coming with the clouds is the one who takes the throne.

2928.prose: Daniel sees the same parting of one people into two ends. Some wake *to everlasting life*, and some *to shame and everlasting contempt*. The verse before speaks of his people, every one found written in the book. So this too is a division among the gathered, as with the sheep and goats.
2928.phrase: some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt
2928.sentence: One people parts into two ends, life for some and shame for others, as at the throne.

2929.prose: The fire on the left hand is Isaiah's fire. Those who go forth look on *the carcases of the men that have transgressed*, and *neither shall their fire be quenched*. A little before it, the seed and its name remain. The seed stays, and the transgressors among them do not.
2929.phrase: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched
2929.sentence: The unquenched fire falls on the transgressors while the seed remains.

2930.prose: Here is who the brethren are. The one who sanctifies and the ones sanctified are *all of one*, and he is not ashamed to call them brethren. The verses after bring in the children Elohim (God) gave him. His brethren are the sanctified seed who share his Father, not a people made up from the nations.
2930.phrase: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren
2930.sentence: He calls the sanctified seed his brethren, and they are the ones the throne counts mercy toward.

2931.prose: The many brethren have a firstborn. Those he calls his own at the throne are the ones Paul says were foreknown and made like the image of his Son, with Yahusha (Jesus) the eldest among them. The family is known before the sifting, and the sifting shows who is in it.
2931.phrase: he might be the firstborn among many brethren
2931.sentence: The brethren are a family with the Son as firstborn, known before the sifting begins.

2932.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) himself says who his brethren are. To Mary, the first witness at the tomb, he says *go to my brethren*, and she carries the word to the disciples. He speaks of *my Father, and your Father*, so his brethren share his Father. The throne's brethren are these.
2932.phrase: go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father
2932.sentence: In his own words the brethren are those who share his Father, and Mary is sent to them.

2933.prose: The women who came to the tomb are sent as witnesses with the word *my brethren*. He gives that name to his own and sends them to Galilee, where they will see him. The name at the throne belongs to the same people, the scattered flock he has come to gather.
2933.phrase: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me
2933.sentence: After the tomb he again calls his own his brethren, the same name the throne uses.

2934.prose: What is done to his own is done to him. Saul was dragging men and women bound to Jerusalem, and the voice asks *why persecutest thou me*. It is the same weighing as the throne, where mercy or its lack toward the least of his brethren is counted as done to him.
2934.phrase: heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me
2934.sentence: Harm done to his people is taken as done to him, the same weighing the throne makes.

2938.prose: The sheep take the kingdom, and this is what they are in it. They are made *kings and priests* and reign on the earth. They are redeemed *out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation* (Revelation 5:9). They are gathered out first and then set over the nations as priests.
2938.phrase: hast made us unto our Elohim (God) kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth
2938.sentence: The sheep who inherit the kingdom reign on the earth as kings and priests.

5073.prose: Capernaum was a city of Yashar'el (Israel), and it saw the mighty works. Yahusha (Jesus) says they would have remained in Sodom had they been done there. The city that heard and refused is judged harder than Sodom. The judgment lands first on those given the most to hear, among his own people.
5073.phrase: the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom
5073.sentence: The city that saw the works and refused is held worse than Sodom, so judgment starts among his own.

5074.prose: Peter treats Sodom and Gomorrah as a warning, *making them an ensample* for the ungodly who came after. The day of judgment Mark names already has its example burned to ashes. Peter then says Elohim (God) delivered just Lot out of it, so the righteous are taken out and the rest are judged.
5074.phrase: making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly
5074.sentence: Sodom and Gomorrah stand as the warning example, with the righteous delivered from among them.
